# Emergency Preparedness Skill for Muse

Your medical safety net for emergencies and travel. It generates emergency medical cards (critical allergies, current medications, conditions, blood type, two emergency contacts, implanted devices) and builds destination-specific travel health risk assessments: vaccine recommendations by region, malaria prophylaxis with medication tables, altitude-sickness prevention by elevation, food/water safety rules, a tailored travel health kit, and a formatted travel health report. It also provides urgent-care triage guidance (emergency / urgent / semi-urgent / self-care) and a table of emergency numbers by country — with a mandatory disclaimer that every travel health output is planning-only and must be verified with a travel medicine specialist. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: general information only — it cannot prescribe, administer vaccines, or replace a real medical consultation; vaccine and medication tables can go stale, so always confirm with a professional before traveling. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
